title: Conveyor
suits: checking, screening, fraud or risk review, QA, moderation, compliance: everything passes through, only the odd one is held

params.--field: the slide field; the machine sits in its own hall card, so it reads on any field
params.--brand: tints the hall, the scanner beam and the checks
params.__MARK__: on the scanner housing (the scanner is the product)
params..st-conveyor-chipt: the tag on the held item (one word: Hold, Review, Fraud?)

details: the belt decelerates like a real one (fast in, easing to a stop) and every parcel rides the same profile
the belt treads and the roller spokes travel with the parcels during the arrival
parcels jiggle on the rollers while moving, each out of step
when the belt stops, every parcel tips forward 2.4° with the inertia and settles
the scanner beam flares for exactly the frames a parcel is under it
a teal check pops above each parcel the moment it leaves the beam
the odd parcel turns the beam amber and an amber scan line sweeps down it
its tag pops up on a string that is drawn on first, overshoots and is left swinging 2° off true
the arch lamp blinks amber twice when the crate is flagged and then stays amber
the fragile box carries a drawn glass glyph; the envelope has a stamp
every parcel has a top and a side face, tape and a label
after rest the belt keeps crawling at 8 px/s and the roller spokes keep turning (ambient, one clock)
faint racks of a sorting hall stand behind the belt
a soft teal halo around the scanner, dashed floor markings
